languageModelTools.name: nx_request_escalation
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Internal control: report a material risk or complexity change with observed facts. Documentation keywords alone cannot support an operation claim. No workspace side effect; NX verifies provenance.

languageModelTools.name: nx_read
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a known workspace-relative file directly. One-based inclusive lines; at most 200 per call. Omit range for lines 1-200; continue with 201-400, etc. Content is capped at 8000 characters per result.

path.description: Known workspace-relative file path. Read directly; no leading/trailing whitespace.

endLine.description: Last line, inclusive. Must be at least startLine and no more than startLine + 199.

languageModelTools.name: nx_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: PATH DISCOVERY: omit query; include one filename glob. CONTENT SEARCH: supply a nonempty case-sensitive literal query. Never use placeholder query text to locate a file. Read known paths directly. Globs cannot have outer whitespace, braces, or comma lists. Returns at most the configured match limit.

query.description: Optional literal content substring. Omit to list matching file paths.

include.description: One nonempty VS Code path glob, e.g. **/AGENTS.md; omit query to discover paths. No outer whitespace, braces, or comma lists.

exclude.description: One nonempty VS Code exclusion glob. No outer whitespace, braces, or comma lists; omit for defaults.

languageModelTools.name: nx_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect bounded VS Code diagnostics for a file or workspace.

path.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: nx_git_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only bounded git status in workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: nx_git_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only bounded git diff; cached true selects staged diff.

languageModelTools.name: nx_create_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new text file after native approval and exact diff Apply.

path.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: nx_edit_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply structured 1-based range edits after native approval and exact diff Apply.

path.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

expectedText.description: Exact current text in the range; detects stale edits.

languageModelTools.name: nx_move_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a file inside workspace after approval and target confirmation.

source.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

destination.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: nx_copy_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copy a file inside workspace after approval and target confirmation.

source.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

destination.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: nx_execute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run allowlisted verification command with argument vector, bounded output and timeout.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative path within the single local workspace root.

nxRouter.telemetry.enabled.description: Store local metadata-only NX Router telemetry in VS Code extension global storage. No cloud upload.

nxRouter.telemetry.retentionDays.description: Keep local telemetry for 1–3650 days; old records are cleaned at activation and when this changes.

nxRouter.execution.timeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout for allowlisted verification commands, in seconds. Per-call timeout remains capped at 120 seconds.

nxRouter.tools.maxReadChars.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes read or edited per file by NX tools; 1024–65536.

nxRouter.tools.maxSearchResults.description: Maximum file/text matches returned by one NX search; 1–100.
